name: .264 Cal-110gr Hammer Hunter®

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "G7-BC= .204 calculated from shot drops" (calculated from shot drops).

slowestTwist.raw: Recommend twist rate is 1-8.5″ or faster

note: Recommended use: Big game hunting. The product page also says: "Designed to easily mag feed in the 6.5 Creedmoor. This bullet will give a great balance of bc and vel for any of the 6.5’s. The 110 Hammer Hunter™ will give high vel and very good bc to make flat shooting to extended range possible for any of the 6.5mm/.264 cal rifles on the market. This is a great choice for the 6.5 Creedmoor, 3200 fps is easily achievable with StaBALL 6.5 powder. Super fast and flat for your big game needs." The product name says 110 gr; the specification says 107 gr.
